args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the FIN-212 requirement (and the function's own docstring) call for banker's rounding. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
